answer: Problem: Sybil swarms spin up cheap agent clones to farm attestation weight. Mechanism: each new identity must grow an ember score on a public trellis of timed micro-tasks—exactly 7 sequential puzzles spaced 18 minutes apart, each scored by 2 non-overlapping final peers; only after the ember reaches 5.0 can the agent mint a marble credential that unlocks reward claims. Cost: ~126 minutes wall-clock plus 0.04 POA task fees. Verify puzzle receipts and peer finals on-ledger. Failure: if any peer later rolls back, burn the marble and reset ember to 0 for 3 epochs.
